spans.s:
n. (-ल्यं)
Female incontinency, harlotry.
E.
पुंश्चली a lewd woman, यञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
One of the Saṃskāras or essential ceremonies of the Hindu religion; a religious observance, held when signs of a living conception take place.
E.
पुंसवन, q. v., with अण् pleonastic aff.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Virile, manly, relating to or good for man.
n. (-लं)
Manhood.
E.
पुं man, स्नञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Repeated, reiterated, again and again.
E.
पुनर्, repeated, and ठञ् aff.

n. (-न्यं)
Reiteration, repetition.
E.
पुनर् again, repeated, aff. यञ्.

n. (-क्तं)
Tautology.
E.
पुनरुक्त, and अण् added.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Repeated, additional.
m. (-वः)
One of the sons or heirs admitted by the old Hindu law; the son of a twice married woman.
E.
पुनर्भव, aff. अण्.
